pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with varying spatial areas. Edges exhibit soft pixel gradients due to fur texture but maintain distinct geometric boundaries. Patches are largest on the upper flank and transition to smaller, more condensed forms on the lower hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological network of light-colored pathways. Intersections primarily feature three-point junction nodes. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, providing clear separation between adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck ridge, consisting of short, upright hairs. The contour is well-defined against the desaturated background.
